summary: Reviewed `docs/operations.md`. No internal contradiction was found, but the procedure lacks details needed for unambiguous execution.
observations: Line 3 clearly establishes a morning check and requires follow-up only after failure.
“Each morning” does not specify a timezone, exact time, or responsible operator.
“The check” and “fails” are undefined, leaving the check procedure and failure criteria unclear.
The note does not say where or how to record the required follow-up.
The worktree remained unchanged; `git diff --check` and the repository-local TypeScript validation completed successfully.
